exercises.q: 改错：The more you expose to English, the better your listening will be.
exercises.answer: The more you expose yourself to English, the better your listening will be.
exercises.explain: expose 是及物动词，需加 yourself 或用 be exposed to。

exercises.q: The more ______ a research question is defined, the more manageable the project becomes.
exercises.explain: 修饰 defined 用副词。此处不是 the + 比较级形容词，而是 the more + adv. + V-ed。

exercises.q: The more inclusive a discussion is, the ______ (rich) the outcome will be.
在正式书面语中，The more urgent the crisis, the more decisive must the response be. 属于可接受的倒装强调。
exercises.explain: 后半句情态动词可提前。

exercises.q: 改写：If a platform gains more attention, advertisers pay higher prices.
exercises.answer: The more attention a platform gains, the higher prices advertisers pay.

exercises.q: 改错：The more complex the algorithm is, the less people understand it.
exercises.answer: The more complex the algorithm is, the fewer people understand it. / The more complex the algorithm is, the less people can understand it.
exercises.explain: people 可数时用 fewer；若视为程度也可用 less people can understand，但标准书面语优选用 fewer people。

exercises.q: The fewer assumptions we make, ______ our argument will stand.
______ the delay, the more expensive the repair will be.
Which option best completes the academic sentence? The more ______ the evidence, the less room there is for prejudice.
The more one ______ to understand opposing views, the less extreme one's own position tends to become.
The less frequently you interrupt, the ______ (smooth) the conversation flows.
exercises.explain: 修饰 flows 用副词 smoothly。

exercises.q: The more one is willing to paraphrase, the ______ (few) misunderstandings arise.
the more of them 这种说法永远错误。
exercises.explain: 限定特定集合时可以用 the more of them / of the data。

exercises.q: 改写：If you keep a more open mind, stereotypes influence you less.
exercises.answer: The more open-minded you keep, the less stereotypes influence you. / The more open your mind is, the less stereotypes influence you.

exercises.q: 改写：If the feedback is more specific, students improve faster.
exercises.answer: The more specific the feedback is, the faster students improve.

exercises.q: 改错：The more you will analyse the strengths, the clearer the plan becomes.
exercises.answer: The more you analyse the strengths, the clearer the plan becomes.

exercises.q: The more ______ a public statement is, the more room it leaves for misinterpretation.
exercises.explain: statement 用形容词 ambiguous 修饰。

exercises.q: The more rigorously a hypothesis is tested, the ______ (credible) the findings become.
“The more a society values empathy, the less discrimination tends to go unchallenged.” 是合格的书面语句。
exercises.explain: 两个比较级共变，时态与主谓一致正确。

exercises.q: 改写：If digital platforms harvest more personal data, users become more vulnerable.
exercises.answer: The more personal data digital platforms harvest, the more vulnerable users become.

exercises.q: 改错：The more fragmented is our attention, the hard it is to complete deep work.
exercises.answer: The more fragmented our attention is, the harder it is to complete deep work.
exercises.explain: 前半句恢复 SV 语序；hard → harder。

exercises.q: ______ the regulation, the greater the incentive for companies to look for loopholes.
The less one is defined by others' expectations, ______ one can act from personal values.
exercises.explain: 修饰 act 用副词 freely。

exercises.q: Which sentence is the most formal and accurate?
options: The more transparent the budgeting process, the stronger public accountability becomes.
The more transparent is budgeting, public accountability stronger becomes.
More transparent the process, stronger the accountability.
The most transparent the process, the stronger accountability.
exercises.answer: The more transparent the budgeting process, the stronger public accountability becomes.
exercises.explain: 正式书面语保持 the + 比较级 成对出现。

exercises.q: The more a narrative ______ on stereotypes, the less insight it actually offers.
The fewer ethical shortcuts a team takes, the ______ (sustainable) its success is.
The more one refuses to drown out dissenting voices, the ______ (rich) the dialogue becomes.
高中书面语里必须在题干中写考试品牌才能使用该结构。
exercises.explain: 这是普通英语结构，与某次考试名称无关。

exercises.q: 改写：If a mentor's guidance is more specific, a student realises more of his or her potential.
exercises.answer: The more specific a mentor's guidance is, the more of his or her potential a student realises.

exercises.q: 改写：If one underestimates complexity less, one adopts more realistic plans.
exercises.answer: The less one underestimates complexity, the more realistic plans one adopts.

exercises.q: 改错：The more you will insist on your first impression, the more prejudice you reinforce.
exercises.answer: The more you insist on your first impression, the more prejudice you reinforce.
